title: killed tab: the answer resumes when the app opens again, replaying sealed model calls from the journal, never calling them again
name: Killed tab
line: An answer cut off by a closed tab finishes when the app opens again, without paying for finished model calls twice.

chapters.label: A: ask "First switch to dark mode and wait for it to finish. Then answer: write kill-lfmvhrec4h6l84 on the first line, count from 1 to 300 in words, one number per line, and write end-lfmvhrec4h6l84 on the last line."
